name: Marin County Suicide Prevention Hotline
description: Buckelew Programs (formerly Family Service Agency of Marin) runs Marin County's suicide prevention hotline as part of the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, plus free grief support groups for people who have lost someone to suicide.
fullDescription: Buckelew Programs (formerly Family Service Agency of Marin) runs Marin County's suicide prevention hotline as part of the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, plus free grief support groups for people who have lost someone to suicide.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24/7 free, confidential suicide prevention and crisis hotline (988)
- Trained counselors for people with suicidal thoughts or emotional distress
- Free suicide bereavement support groups on Zoom (adults, ages 14-24, and Spanish speakers)
- Suicide prevention education for schools, workplaces, and organizations
howToGetIt: Call or text 988 anytime. Calls from Marin are answered by Buckelew's local 988 counselors. Marin County's resource guide also lists Buckelew's local hotline at 415-499-1100.
keywords: Marin County, suicide prevention, Buckelew Programs, 988, crisis hotline, grief support group, Allies for Hope
